posts.headline: Championshipsovercoochie has the best record in Busters Anonymous at 8-1 with 1269.1 points-for, and the African Bald Fraud bit has to be retired until this man loses a game.
posts.detail: Two seasons of middling 4th-place finishes and now mjwithgoldhoops is running away with the league at 8-1 and a league-high 1269.1 points-for. Fraud? This is the most legitimate thing happening in this league right now.

posts.headline: Thicks' Klint's Clipboard is 7-2 but still can't crack the top tier in points-for, and a champion's ring shouldn't need an apology attached to it.
posts.detail: 1026.8 points-for is middle-of-the-pack production propping up a 7-2 record, and with an 0.5 career win pct and 5.5 average finish, this title defense is still running on borrowed credibility, not dominance.

posts.headline: Chauncey's talentedtenthh is cratering at 2-7 with a league-worst 934.22 points-for, and a 12th-place average finish says this isn't bad luck, it's a pattern.
posts.detail: A 4-10 career record and a 0.286 win pct make the untalented tenth bit less of a joke and more of a scouting report at this point.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's Put it in Ra is stuck at 2-7 and the best résumé this league has ever produced — a 20-8 career record, 1.5 average finish — is now a cautionary tale told to rookies.
posts.detail: Two titles' worth of pedigree and this man can't buy a win right now, sitting at 929.86 points-for, dead last alongside the actual bottom-feeders. The fall from 1.5 average finish to this is the most shocking collapse in the league.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT is winless at 0-9, and Eli's Ultimate Light Skin is now officially this league's longest-running plague of locusts.
posts.detail: A 13-14-1 career record already screamed mediocrity, but 0-9 with 974.68 points-for means the Belt has been chosen every single week this season — scripture offers no comfort for this kind of suffering.
